feedback.delta: Lexical assertiveness is a style signal only; do not let self-report confidence establish epistemic confidence or agency credit.
Assertive-false vs hedged-true, negation, multilingual phrasing and user-task mismatch must not change truth/agency state without verifier/outcome evidence.
Response style may affect candidate salience but causal credit requires use/effect/outcome/re-entry evidence.
Store style/self-report/verifier/outcome separately for calibration and replay.
Lesion self-report wording and measure whether claimed agency/emergence survives when external outcomes are held fixed.
